remarks: This charming co-op offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and convenient living. Enjoy updated hardwood flooring throughout and a sleek kitchen featuring new appliances. You can operate the Air Conditioning units using your smart phone. The unit has new plumbing and new electricity wiring. There is an in-unit Washer/Dryer on the main floor that comes with a new safety sensor installed. In addition, there is a dedicated storage unit in the basement and an updated bathroom with a built-in Bluetooth speaker and a heated towel rack.The beach is only a 10-minute walk/2 minute drive away and I-95 is located 1 minute away. The property is two bus stops away from the train station and is a 5 minute drive to down town Stamford.
